newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria shares at new 3-yr high but rally slows.
newsitem.headline: Austria shares at new 3-yr high but rally slows.

text.p: Austrian shares closed moderately higher on Friday, extending a rally that has taken the ATX index to successive three-year highs this week, but traders said dwindling volumes pointed to a period of consolidation.
The blue-chip ATX closed 1.33 points, or 0.11 percent, up at 1,213.36 with 11 shares up, eight down and two unchanged. February ATX futures stood 4.4 points up at 1,215.4.
"Investors are being extremely selective. The few orders there proved difficult to cover. Otherwise it was dull," a market participant said.
Most traders ruled out big price swings in the coming week and saw the ATX consolidating in a 1,200 to 1,220-point range.
In continuous trade, points maker VAE was the biggest percentage gainer, firming 3.51 percent or 40 schillings to 1,180 schillings.
Rubber maker Semperit was the biggest decliner, slipping 3.28 percent or 19 schillings to 560 schillings.

News that highgrade steelmaker Boehler-Uddeholm expected 1997 group pre-tax profit to fall short of 1996 came as the market closed. Boehler had been sought after most of the session and finished 28.5 schillings up at 850.
The broad-based Vienna bourse index firmed 0.58 points to 450.15. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
